review_kind: assistant editorial review; not participant research
scope: Static source candidates are conservative and include some non-visible selector literals. User-authored text and generated professional prompts are excluded.

perspective_matrix.first_time: Heading is an invitation; support and CTA explain prompt preparation. No automatic comprehension is promised.
perspective_matrix.returning: Only a completed action in this session selects returning copy. No elapsed-time or personal profile inference.
perspective_matrix.non_native_english: Short familiar verbs; shape is a metaphor grounded by explicit prompt wording. Native-speaker localization remains pending.
perspective_matrix.creator: Creative task selection picks editorial copy without flattering talent.
perspective_matrix.developer: Exact execution and integrity details remain under inspection/proof.
perspective_matrix.business: Goal, resources and boundaries are explicit; no ROI promise.
perspective_matrix.skeptical_expert: Editable-template operation and pending independent qualification are disclosed.
perspective_matrix.privacy_conscious: Core input stays on device during preparation; hosting sign-in and downstream AI use are distinguished.
perspective_matrix.mobile: Short action profiles; hero layout requires visual review at breakpoints.
perspective_matrix.screen_reader: Labels name the action; technical details use native disclosure controls. Accessibility certification is not claimed.
